viewdef:
SELECT j.id,
    j.court,
    j.judgment_date,
        CASE
            WHEN j.script_quality IS NULL THEN 'TEXT_UNKNOWN'::text
            WHEN j.script_quality = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'mixed_script_ok'::text]) THEN 'TEXT_UNKNOWN'::text
            ELSE 'TEXT_DAMAGED'::text
        END AS text_state,
    j.script_quality AS text_value,
    j.script_quality_method AS text_method,
    j.script_quality_at AS text_at,
        CASE
            WHEN j.script_quality IS NULL OR (j.script_quality = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'mixed_script_ok'::text])) THEN 'NONE'::text
            WHEN j.script_quality_method = 'text-damage-v2.0'::text THEN 'PROOF'::text
            ELSE 'SCREEN'::text
        END AS text_grade,
    COALESCE(q.state, 'NOT_QUEUED'::text) AS recovery_state,
    q.reason AS recovery_reason,
    r.method AS recovery_method,
    r.engine_version AS recovery_engine,
    r.char_count AS recovery_chars,
    r.created_at AS recovered_at,
    r.digit_trust,
    d.state AS date_state,
    d.method AS date_method,
    d.off_by_one_day,
    j.hc_document_class AS role_class,
    j.hc_class_method AS role_method,
        CASE
            WHEN j.hc_document_class = ANY (ARRAY['procedural_disposal'::text, 'reference_stub'::text]) THEN 'NOT_CITABLE'::text
            WHEN j.hc_document_class = 'bail_order'::text THEN 'BAIL_ORDER'::text
            ELSE 'CITABILITY_UNKNOWN'::text
        END AS citability,
    j.script_quality IS NULL OR (j.script_quality = ANY (ARRAY['clean'::text, 'mixed_script_ok'::text])) AS body_text_safe,
    j.content_hash IS NOT NULL AND j.case_number IS NOT NULL AND j.court IS NOT NULL AND length(COALESCE(j.case_title, ''::text)) > 3 AS metadata_discoverable
   FROM judgments j
     LEFT JOIN judgment_recovery_queue q ON q.judgment_id = j.id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT tr.method,
            tr.engine_version,
            tr.char_count,
            tr.digit_trust,
            tr.created_at
           FROM judgment_text_recovery tr
          WHERE tr.judgment_id = j.id
          ORDER BY tr.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON true
     LEFT JOIN judgment_date_quality d ON d.judgment_id = j.id;
